historical_task_checks.interpretation: Small, formatting-sensitive task checks; not a comparative model-quality benchmark.

selection_rationale: The 17/15/13 PP3 partition preserves much more KV than 17/14/14 with the same AWQ target weights. Historical 262,144-context short-output waves recorded higher decode throughput than the EXL3 comparison. The newer 524,288-context C1/C4 pair records 36.92/110.14 tok/s, with lower C1 decode than the retained EXL3 headline. These cohorts differ in inputs, settings, driver epoch and third physical card; they do not isolate a backend or quantization effect. AWQ uses a separate BF16 DFlash2 head.
